description: Emails a client from the business mailbox on your person's order, as a Manual send under the business's Sending setting. First call without confirm_token: nothing is sent; you get a preview (to, subject and the exact text) and a confirm_token. Show your person the preview word for word, and only after they say yes, call again with the same arguments and the SAME idempotency_key, plus confirm_token. replyToEmailId threads it as a reply to that inbound email.

confirm_token.description: From the preview, after your person said yes. Leave it out to get the preview.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: send_email
title: Send an email (after your person confirms)
